g.text: Direct shell growth to a 30-ML target
general minimum duration: 2 h; at least
Direct-method text states at least 2 h; the worked 30-ML example specifies 4 h and p.7
describes 4–6 h across the series. These statements retain their own scope.
Continuing 25 mL three-neck round-bottom flask with septum, thermowell/thermometer and
condenser; dual syringe-pump feeds where specified.
Source: Main PDF p.10, Experimental Methods, Direct Shelling of CdSe with CdS; Main PDF p.3,
